run.state_sampling: 1001 states at t=n*h including initial; raw Newton body_q/qd,joint_q/qd and native qpos/qvel stored. Native integration owns qpos/qvel after initialization because update_data_interval=0; no midrun state edit.
run.force_sampling: 1000 raw mj_data qfrc_passive/qfrc_actuator/qfrc_applied/qfrc_constraint/qacc/nefc/solver_niter samples immediately AFTER mj_step. For Euler these forces were evaluated at pre-integration state n, whereas qpos/qvel are state n+1. Store force_t=n*h and compare force[n] to state[n], never silently treat as endpoint forces. No extra mj_forward changes native integration state.
run.finite: every physical, native, command and diagnostic array finite; no initial unsolved force sample inserted

reference: Independent float64 scalar reference with I=I_com_y+m*(com_x^2+com_z^2)+armature. MuJoCo Euler includes joint damping implicitly, actuator PD damping explicitly: tau_act=kp*(qref-q_n)-kd*v_n, v_next=(I*v_n+h*(external_tau+tau_act))/(I+h*damping), q_next=q_n+h*v_next. This is not Kamino's fully implicit PD recurrence. Passive force reported is -damping*v_n even though the velocity integration uses implicit damping. Limit case uses only preactivation free-flight recurrence and late static force balance/range translation, not an invented exact soft-limit transient solution.

cases.title: 被动关节阻尼：无驱动自由转子的能量衰减
cases.interpretation: damping is always-active passive dissipation, not joint_target_kd and not dry friction. v_n=v0*(I/(I+h*damping))^n, E=.5*I*v^2; also report continuous exp(-d*t/I) as secondary discretization comparison.
cases.rationale: Damped endpoint speed ~exp(-4)=.0183 and energy ratio ~.00034, so <=.03/<=.001 reject absent damping while tolerating Euler discretization. Zero-damping control must conserve speed/energy.

cases.title: Armature：同力矩下的有效惯量与加速度
cases.interpretation: I_eff=1+armature. Armature changes rotational generalized inertia while body mass and physical inertia remain fixed; it is not damping. With constant 1Nm, a=1/I_eff, v_n=n*h/I_eff, q_n=h*h*n*(n+1)/(2*I_eff).
cases.rationale: 0 versus3 makes effective inertia1 versus4 and acceleration/speed exactly quarter, a strong discriminating ratio independent of curve appearance.

cases.title: 驱动阻尼：同位置增益下振荡与收敛
cases.interpretation: Only target_kd changes. kp25 supplies restoring actuation, kd10 critically damps I1 in the continuous limit. Euler actuator damping remains explicit; whole trajectory/torque must match the discrete scalar reference. This validates kp export at25 but is not a kp sweep.
cases.rationale: No-damping oscillator reaches near .2rad while critical damping approaches .1rad without large overshoot; .002s is far below the explicit stability scale. Force margin excludes saturation as explanation.

cases.title: 关节上限：到达时刻、软约束反力与停止位置
cases.reference_scope: Compute free-flight q_n=h²*n*(n+1)/2; expected activation force_t is first pre-step n with q_n>=upper. Actual first force_t with abs(qfrc_constraint)>1e-6 must match within .006s. Compare q/v to free-flight only through that first activation input state. Tail is last250steps (.5s): external+constraint=0, small speed, plateau near specified range. Shift of plateau follows .1rad range change. Do not claim exact transient soft-limit force or zero penetration.
cases.rationale: Expected arrival ~.446/.632s; range shift creates ~.185s delay. Force-space limit_ke20000/kd1000 and fixed default solimp are intended to absorb impact with bounded penetration; record actual exported response parameters. A failed penetration/settling gate remains a negative result, not permission to hard-clamp q.

provenance: All809 installed locked Newton Python files checked against manifests/source-lock.json each run. Record native package version, actual mj_model fields and native integration options. New run directory every attempt, with raw NPZ, protocol and runner copies+SHA, result and full log. Keep failed attempts; harness fixes require parent approval and new runner hash. No physical thresholds changed after observing results.
limitations: Native CPU MuJoCo3.15.0 with Newton1.7.0 only; no MuJoCo Warp claim
One scalar joint, diagonal constant inertia, no gravity/contact or coupled joints
Euler selected for auditable discrete references; not a recommendation over default implicitfast
Joint limit is soft and transient waveform is not claimed analytically reproduced
No kp sweep, effort/velocity-limit sweep or runtime property update tested
Model export/native diagnostic arrays are observational instrumentation
